recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future corrections to discrete-variant modeling should be made in HL7/genomics-reporting or the published Genomics Reporting IG, not in this FHIR core checkout, unless the Clinical Genomics work group explicitly moves this content back into core.
issue_request: FHIR-14317 asked to create a DiscreteVariant profile under the STU3 Observation-genetics profile, including Sequence derivedFrom linkage, LOINC-coded discrete-variant, variant-assessment, and variant-analysis method elements, plus VariantChange, GenomicLocation, AllelicState, and AminoAcidChange component groups. Jira status is Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution that says this was already applied using DescribedVariant in the Genomics Reporting IG.
initial_application: No FHIR-core git commit in this checkout mentions FHIR-14317, DiscreteVariant, DescribedVariant, or obs-described-variant. Core history shows older Observation-genetics material was updated separately in 2018 and removed from core as outdated clinical genomics artifacts in 2020. Current source/fhir.ini has active Observation and DiagnosticReport resources and profile configuration, but no active Observation-genetics, DiscreteVariant, or DescribedVariant profile entry.
additional_context: Current FHIR core narrative for genomics, Observation, and DiagnosticReport directs implementers to the Genomics Reporting IG for structured genomic data. The FHIR Extension Pack copy of the old observation-geneticsVariant extension is retired/deprecated and states it was replaced by profiles and extensions in the Genomics Reporting Guide. The current Genomics Reporting IG package exposes an active Variant Observation profile as the successor locus for this variant modeling family. Related component-group issues are FHIR-genomics-reporting issues, and the neighboring FHIR-14318 core StructuralVariant request has already been audited on the combined branch as external IG work.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch and made no FHIR-core source change. Recreating a DiscreteVariant/Observation-genetics profile in core would be out of current build scope and would conflict with the accepted external IG resolution.
